name: sinewy
description: Strong, flexible UI components for Sin.js.

scripts.test: npm run test:browser && npm run test:ssr && npm run test:types && npm run test:docs
scripts.test:docs: npm run docs:content && node test/docs.test.js && node test/docs.ssr.test.js
scripts.test:ssr: node test/dropdown.ssr.test.js && node test/context-menu.ssr.test.js && node test/button.ssr.test.js && node test/toggle.ssr.test.js && node test/dialog.ssr.test.js && node test/alert-dialog.ssr.test.js && node test/switch.ssr.test.js && node test/select.ssr.test.js && node test/custom-select.ssr.test.js && node test/checkbox.ssr.test.js && node test/radio.ssr.test.js && node test/combobox.ssr.test.js && node test/split-panel.ssr.test.js
scripts.test:types: tsc --noEmit --strict --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 --lib ES2022,DOM --skipLibCheck test/dropdown.types.test.ts test/context-menu.types.test.ts test/button.types.test.ts test/toggle.types.test.ts test/dialog.types.test.ts test/alert-dialog.types.test.ts test/switch.types.test.ts test/select.types.test.ts test/custom-select.types.test.ts test/checkbox.types.test.ts test/radio.types.test.ts test/combobox.types.test.ts test/split-panel.types.test.ts
